_about: Hand-curated font list. Each entry: [fontsource id, roles, moods, note, source repo or null]. `fonts.py refresh` merges this with live Fontsource metadata into catalog.json. Edit this file to add or retag fonts, then run refresh.
_roles: ui = interface/body sans; text = long-form reading; display = headlines/hero; editorial = magazine/serif voice; mono = code/data; arabic = Arabic-script UI/text; urdu = Nastaliq/Urdu-appropriate; cjk = Chinese/Japanese/Korean
_moods: neutral corporate techy friendly playful elegant luxury editorial bold geometric humanist grotesque retro warm accessible minimal expressive condensed handwritten classic modern rounded
fonts: The default modern UI sans. Huge character set, opsz axis, tabular figures. Safe choice for any product UI.
Tighter-spaced Inter for big headlines; pairs with Inter body.
Vercel's sans. Crisp Swiss-ish feel, the 'developer product' look.
Matching mono for Geist; great for code, stats and labels.
GitHub's variable sans with width axis; strong expressive headlines.
Mona Sans' geometric sibling; robotic, wide headline voice.
IBM's corporate workhorse. Full superfamily incl. Arabic, so ideal for bilingual enterprise work.
Serif companion in the Plex family.
Arabic designed to match Plex Sans Latin exactly. Best pick for bilingual enterprise/telecom UIs.
Condensed Plex for dense tables, dashboards and tight headings.
US government's neutral sans. Calm, legible, very trustworthy for fintech/gov.
Adobe's humanist workhorse; easy long reading.
Adobe's transitional serif with optical sizes; excellent body serif.
Variable sans<->mono with a 'casual' axis. Fun for dev tools and playful brands.
Retro-futurist mono; good for accents and labels, not long code.
Grotesque optimised for screen at mid sizes; versatile.
Soft 'Old Style' display serif with WONK and SOFT axes. Instant character for food, lifestyle, editorial.
Futura-inspired geometric; fashion and premium minimal brands.
Semi-condensed modern grotesk; popular in fintech and SaaS.
Low-contrast geometric sans with opsz; friendly product UI.
High-contrast display serif; elegant headlines over DM Sans.
Polished modern geometric; very common in SaaS/startup sites.
Clean geometric with round shapes; great for consumer apps and branding.
Wide geometric sans built for tech; crypto/fintech look.
Designed to reduce visual stress and improve reading speed; good for education and accessibility-first products.
Braille Institute's hyperlegible face; best when low-vision legibility matters.
Ubiquitous geometric. Fine for headings; overused, and heavy for body text.
Urban geometric; strong uppercase headings. Very common.
Clean friendly geometric; a fresher Poppins alternative for body.
Neutral grotesk with great Cyrillic; calm product UI.
Sharp contemporary grotesque; precise, design-studio feel.
Condensed display serif; the trendy 'editorial landing page' headline.
Quirky variable grotesque with opsz and width; personality-heavy headlines.
Clean minimal grotesk; a quieter Inter alternative.
Grotesque with width axis; great for data-heavy and sporty brands.
Art-gallery display face; extreme at heavy weights.
Wide rounded display; bold web3/gaming headlines.
High-contrast Didone-ish display; classic luxury/editorial headline.
Delicate Garamond display; weddings, jewellery, fashion. Too thin for small body.
Faithful Garamond revival; books and literary long-form.
Baskerville optimised for screen body text.
Brushed contemporary serif; warm long-form reading.
Sturdy screen serif; readable at small sizes.
Production Type's news serif with opsz; premium reading experience.
Google Play Books' reading face; built for long-form on screen.
Screen-first serif by Production Type; refined and light.
Didone with opsz; fashion magazine headlines.
High-contrast heavy serif; dramatic posters and hero lines.
Heavy old-style serif; cosy, retro, food and craft brands.
Tall x-height coding mono with ligatures; best all-round code font.
The original ligature coding font (82k stars).
Mozilla's humanist sans; very readable, large script support.
Microsoft's terminal font with ligatures and cursive italic; includes Arabic.
GitHub Next's mono superfamily with texture healing. Not on Google Fonts, use Fontsource or self-host.
Intel's mono designed for low-vision developers.
Narrow, endlessly configurable coding font. Not on Google Fonts.
Wide variable mono by Evil Martians; striking for UI accents.
Neutral, anonymous coding mono with smart kerning. Not on Google Fonts.
Rounded mono with ligatures (29k stars). Not on Google Fonts.
Mono with cursive italics; fun for editor themes and code blocks.
Android's mono; neutral partner for Roboto.
Best modern Arabic-script UI font. Variable 100-900, built-in Latin (Roboto-based). Works for Arabic, Persian and basic Urdu Naskh UI.
Google's universal Arabic sans; widest language coverage incl. Urdu letters.
Traditional Naskh for readable body text, incl. Urdu-specific letters.
Geometric Kufi; headlines and modern brand marks.
The standard Nastaliq for Urdu. Very tall: needs line-height 2+ and a large size. File is ~500KB, so subset it.
Nastaliq display face for Urdu headings; more calligraphic than Noto.
Classical Naskh (Bulaq press style); formal and Quranic-quality text.
Ruqaa calligraphic display; heritage, invitations, Ramadan campaigns.
Contemporary Arabic + Latin; very common on Gulf brand sites.
Low-contrast geometric Arabic; clean Saudi/Gulf product UI. No Latin glyphs (pair with a Latin face) and no Urdu letters.
Simple modern Arabic sans used widely in KSA apps. Arabic only.
Lexend's Arabic extension; readability-focused, variable. Arabic only: lacks Urdu letters.
Geometric Arabic+Latin, 9 weights; bold contemporary headlines.
Elegant modern Arabic display with matching Latin.
Condensed Arabic+Latin display; sporty, gaming, energetic.
Arabic+Latin text face for news and editorial body.
Slightly rounded sans with Arabic and Hebrew; friendly consumer apps. Arabic set lacks Urdu letters.
Chunky rounded Arabic+Latin; kids, games, playful brands.
Universal fallback sans covering almost every script.
Simplified Chinese sans (Source Han Sans based).
Korean system-ui alternative (Inter + Source Han). Not on Google Fonts.
Android's system font; neutral, safe, a bit generic.
Roboto with 13 variable axes (width, grade, opsz...). Great for motion/variable-font effects.
Classic humanist web font; safe but dated-feeling.
Rounded terminals; kids, health, friendly consumer apps.
Quirky grotesque with character at small sizes.
Red Hat's display face; confident corporate headlines.
Text companion of Red Hat Display.
Fresh variable sans; modern SaaS alternative to Inter.
Slightly rounded Californian grotesk; dashboards and signage feel.
Condensed Barlow for sporty, data-dense headings.
Condensed gothic; posters, sports, news headings.
All-caps condensed display; posters and hero numbers. Uppercase only.
Heavy condensed impact face; thumbnails and posters.
Chicago-inspired condensed display; civic, sporty, industrial.
Heavy grotesque for punchy single-weight headlines.
Natural handwriting; annotations, notes, casual accents.
Marker pen; very casual accents only.
Surf-style script; retro logos and accents only.
8-bit arcade pixel font; games and retro accents, tiny doses.
CRT terminal pixel font; retro tech accents.
Self-host consistent colour emoji across platforms.
